experiment: K55: Can Adding a Third Asset Beat 50/50 SPY/GLD?
description: 50/50 SPY/GLD + 12/VIX is the 'unbeatable' portfolio. This tests 3-asset (TLT/IEF/TIP/VNQ/BTC) and 4-asset configurations, plus risk-parity and mean-variance optimization, to determine if any combination can beat the baseline.

strategies.A5: 40/40/20 SPY/GLD/TLT: Tilt toward SPY/GLD with TLT diversifier
strategies.A6: 40/40/20 SPY/GLD/IEF: Tilt toward SPY/GLD with IEF diversifier
strategies.A7: 40/40/20 SPY/GLD/TIP: Tilt toward SPY/GLD with TIPS diversifier
strategies.A8: 40/40/20 SPY/GLD/VNQ: Tilt toward SPY/GLD with REIT diversifier

conclusion: Best Full-Sample Sharpe: A9: 45/45/10 SPY/GLD/BTC — Sharpe=1.197
